name: Hidden Pit (BB)

stealth.note: (or DC 0 Perception check if the trapdoor is disabled or broken)

description: A wooden trapdoor covers a 10-foot square pit that's 20 feet deep.
disable: DC 12 Thievery check to remove the trapdoor.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pitfall
offensiveAbilities.description: If a creature walks onto the trapdoor, that creature falls in unless it succeeds at a DC 16 Reflex save to grab hold of the edge. The pit is 20 feet deep, dealing 10 bludgeoning damage to anyone who falls to the bottom.
